label: Caption - Editorial Emphasis
description: Magazine-style caption where most words fade in plain while key words pop in accent color with a drawn underline for editorial emphasis.

emphasis.label: Emphasis Words
emphasis.description: Specific words to emphasize with accent color and underline. If omitted, every Nth word is emphasized automatically.

everyN.label: Auto Emphasis Interval
everyN.description: When no emphasis list is given, emphasize every Nth word.

accent.label: Emphasis Color
accent.description: Color for emphasized words and underlines (maps to --mp-color-accent).
